Dashboard styles
format:
<style>
#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat {
    --dash-panel: #1a2021;
    --dash-card: #202829;
    --dash-border: #374446;
    --dash-muted: #b4c3c3;
    --dash-teal: #83ddd0;
    --dash-amber: #ffc28f;
    --dash-gap: .5rem;
    --dash-radius: .75rem;
    --dash-gauge-height: 9.5rem;
    --dash-chart-height: 15.5rem;
    display: grid;
    gap: .875rem;
    width: min(calc(100% - 2rem), 62rem);
    margin: 1rem auto 1.5rem;
}

/* Dashboard 3 writes its panel and widget geometry inline. Override it so
   the native widgets can reflow without horizontal scrolling. */
#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat,
#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer {
    height: auto !important;
    min-height: 0 !important;
}

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat ui-card-panel,
#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer > * {
    position: static;
    min-width: 0;
}

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat ui-card-panel {
    padding: .75rem;
    background: var(--dash-panel);
    border: 1px solid var(--dash-border);
    border-radius: var(--dash-radius);
}

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .nr-dashboard-cardtitle {
    width: auto !important;
    min-height: 0;
    max-height: none;
    margin: 0 0 .625rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
    font-weight: 650;
}

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .nr-dashboard-cardcontainer {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(6, minmax(0, 1fr));
    gap: var(--dash-gap);
    width: auto !important;
}

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-readings .thermostat-gauge { grid-column: span 2; }
#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-freshness { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-readings .thermostat-gauge:nth-last-child(-n+2),
#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-history .thermostat-chart { grid-column: span 3; }

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat md-card {
    box-sizing: border-box;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    padding: var(--dash-gap);
    background: var(--dash-card);
    border: 1px solid var(--dash-border);
    border-radius: var(--dash-radius);
    box-shadow: none;
}

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-freshness {
    justify-content: flex-start;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: .25rem .625rem;
    padding-inline: .75rem;
    font-size: .875rem;
}

.thermostat-freshness .label { color: var(--dash-muted); }
.thermostat-freshness .value { font-weight: 600; }

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-gauge {
    min-height: var(--dash-gauge-height);
    padding-block: .375rem .125rem;
}

.thermostat-gauge [id^="gauge_"] { max-width: 100%; }
.thermostat-current .label { color: var(--dash-teal); }
.thermostat-setpoint .label { color: var(--dash-amber); }

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-chart {
    height: var(--dash-chart-height) !important;
}

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .nr-dashboard-chart {
    height: calc(100% - 2.75rem);
    width: 100%;
    padding: 0;
}

#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .nr-dashboard-gauge-title,
#Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .nr-dashboard-chart-title {
    font-size: .9375rem;
    font-weight: 650;
}

@media (max-width: 52rem) {
    #Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-readings .thermostat-gauge { grid-column: span 3; }
    #Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-readings .thermostat-setpoint:nth-child(n),
    #Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-history .thermostat-chart { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}

@media (max-width: 34rem) {
    #Tab_Glasgow_thermostat { width: calc(100% - 1rem); }
    #Tab_Glasgow_thermostat .thermostat-readings .thermostat-gauge:nth-child(n) { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
}
</style>
